actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Meloni is currently at the center of a diplomatic dispute with former U.S. President Donald Trump after he made derogatory remarks about her during a TV interview. Her strong rebuttal and the subsequent solidarity from EU leaders have dominated headlines, overshadowing other policy discussions. The controversy has escalated tensions between Italy and the U.S., with Italy canceling diplomatic visits in response.
